verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama can run multiple models concurrently (ollama-docs-17), but nothing documents any control over how context memory is allocated across concurrent instances. Community evidence suggests server memory configuration is hidden behind defaults rather than exposed to users. Concurrency alone is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
